 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. It's officially awards season in MLB, with Gold Gloves already handed out and the BBWAA announcing its winners over the course of this week . Nearly every other award was revealed on Wednesday in the 2026 MLB Awards Show.
 The All-MLB first and second teams, introduced in 2019, were both revealed over the course of the night, with overwhelming MVP favorites Yordan Álvarez of the Houston Astros and Pete Crow-Armstrong of the Chicago Cubs leading the way on the first team.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Álvarez and Crow-Armstrong both won their respective league's Hank Aaron Awards, recognizing them as the top-performing offensive players. Álvarez also took home his first Edgar Martinez Outstanding Designated Hitter Award, breaking a five-year streak held by Los Angeles Dodgers superstar Shohei Ohtani, and AL Comeback Player of the Year.
 With the Hank Aaron Award and the NL Platinum Glove , Crow-Armstrong has now won the awards for being both the best offensive player and defensive player in the NL. He is the first player in the history of MLB to do that in either league.
